name: quartic_model
title: Quartic Model (Manifold Lifting Toy Example)
description: A two-dimensional toy model from Au, Graham and Thiery (2020). Parameters theta = (theta_0, theta_1) have independent standard normal priors, and a single observation y is modelled as Normal(F(theta), sigma) with known noise scale sigma and quartic forward function F(theta) = theta_1^2 + theta_0^2 (theta_0^2 - 1/2). With one observation and two unknowns the model is non-identifiable: as sigma decreases, the posterior concentrates in a band of width O(sigma) around the closed curve F(theta) = y, creating a thin, curved ridge that forces standard HMC step sizes to shrink with sigma.
